title: Recommended design values of settlement ratios
markdown:
|  | Type of Conduit | Type of Soil | Settlement Ratio |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Rigid | Rock or unyielding foundation | + 1.0 |
| 2 | Rigid | Ordinary foundation | + 0.5 to + 0.8 |
| 3 | Rigid | Yielding foundation | 0 to + 0.5 |
| 4 | Rigid | Negative projecting installation | 0.3 to 0.5 |
| 5 | Flexible | Poorly compacted side fill | 0.4 to 0 |
| 6 | Flexible | Well compacted side fill | 0 |
notes: Transcriber note: the descending range 0.4 to 0 is preserved as printed.
